The importance of the plan writing and revising is to make sure that We have a current idea of what our hazards are in each municipality in the county. So it's it's a it's a very thorough project usually takes a year took an extra year this time but it goes through and they solicit information from all the municipalities all the public utilities all school districts pretty much everybody that comes in contact with Lancaster County in the municipalities and they try to get a good idea of what the hazards are both natural manmade criminal in certain circumstances.
